description: Get detailed information about a specific siren

fields.name: modelKey
fields.description: The model key of the siren

fields.name: guid
fields.description: Stable identifier for the device model.

fields.name: mac
fields.description: The primary MAC address of the device.

children.name: activatedAt
children.description: Timestamp when the siren was activated.

fields.name: connectionType
fields.description: The connection type of the siren.

fields.name: wirelessConnectionState
fields.description: Wireless connection state including signal quality, battery status, and bridge connection.

children.name: signalQuality
children.description: Percent representation of Bluetooth signal strength.

children.name: signalStrength
children.description: dBm value of Bluetooth signal strength.

children.name: bridge
children.description: The ID of the bridge this device is connected through.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/sirens/{id}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get siren details
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/sirens/{id}"
    method: GET
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
